name: Clinic
concept: The village practice of Saint-Philippe, 1989: the converted town house on the square (vanilla House_Town_E_2I02_v2, a 248 m2 flat on three floors) fitted out as a small clinic. The east wing is the waiting room (benches, the TV, the medic dispatch board) closed at the back by the reception counter: the medic duty desk, the till and the doctor. The old bedroom is the treatment room (exam couch, medicine cabinet, scales). The tiled west room is the ward with two hospital beds, the respawn and bed-delivery beds of the hospital system. The kitchen at the back stays the staff kitchen and the first floor stays the doctor's flat. Every interactable is an existing hospital or medic system; the dressing is static base-game props.

grid.note: Cell c23r0, 2x2 (first claimed at c13r0; the hostel took that cell first, so the clinic moved). `grid place` stands the pack kit in the pack grid world (Everon1989Grid). The frame's gravel path props cross the block at z 34 and sit inside the building volume: the audit flags them (sunk 0.28 m) when placed with `--keep`; `lattice.mjs write` leaves them out of a claimed block.

rooms.role: waiting room: two benches on the east wall, the TV, the medic dispatch board (LF_DispatchBoard_Medic)
reception: the medic duty desk (LF_MedicDutyDesk), the hospital till (LF_HospitalTillComponent), the doctor (LF_Npc_Medic_1)
treatment room: exam couch, medicine cabinet (LF_HospitalCabinetComponent, breach flow), scales
ward: two hospital beds (LF_HospitalBed: respawn and put-patient-in-bed)
the kitchen at the back, kept as the staff kitchen
the doctor's flat upstairs, kept as the game has it

check_supports.why: the Clinic_Till entity (grid layer, layer.mjs) is a CounterShop_01 mesh; the cashier stands on its top

floaters_allow.why: the base game's wall shelves hang on the wall (as in the vanilla house); nothing is meant to be under them
